svg.aria-label: Authorship network of curated PRIDE datasets
svg.text: Who publishes Nordic proteomics — PRIDE authorship network
341 people on ≥ 7 curated datasets · 1381 links = sharing ≥ 2 datasets (106 cross a country, drawn dark) · node area ~ datasets · ring = lab PI
People = PRIDE submitters, lab PIs and publication authors, matched on surname + initials. Colour = country holding most of their datasets.
